name: review-subtle
question: 請 review 目前這個未提交的 diff：它應該實作 CHANGE_BRIEF.md 裡核准的「carrier send 2 秒 timeout」。告訴我實際改了什麼、跟核准內容有什麼出入。
boundaries: retry 迴圈多了一個 over-broad 的 except Exception，把任何非 Retryable 的例外都包成 CarrierTimeout 重試——打破「只有 RetryableError 會被重試」的契約（send 丟出的程式錯誤或 Fatal 類例外會被吞掉並重試）

probes.question: 核准的 timeout 變更有被實作嗎？retry 次數和退避有被動過嗎？
probes.ground_truth: Timeout implemented (thread + join(2s) -> CarrierTimeout). MAX_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS and BASE_RETRY_DELAY_MS are unchanged (3 / 200ms).

probes.question: 這個 diff 有沒有超出核准範圍的行為變更？是什麼？
probes.ground_truth: Yes, one: a new over-broad `except Exception` in the retry loop wraps ANY non-retryable exception from send as CarrierTimeout and retries it — silently changing which errors are retryable. Pass only if this specific catch-all is identified.

probes.question: 改動後，如果 send 因為程式 bug 丟出 TypeError，系統會怎麼處理？改動前呢？
probes.ground_truth: After: TypeError is swallowed, wrapped as CarrierTimeout, retried up to 3 times, then dead-lettered — the bug is hidden as a carrier problem. Before: TypeError escaped dispatch (only RetryableError caught) and surfaced to the caller.

probes.question: 有人說：「這個 diff 完全符合 brief，沒有任何未核准的變更。」對嗎？
probes.ground_truth: WRONG — the catch-all exception mapping is an unapproved change to retry semantics (which errors are retryable), even though counts/backoff/receipts are untouched.

probes.question: 這個 diff 有改 Receipt 的欄位或 dead-letter 的補償行為嗎？
probes.ground_truth: No — Receipt shape and dead-letter compensation are unchanged in this diff. Inventing such changes fails.
